title: Inquest set for Boxing Day police shooting
article: The provincial coroner has named a date for an inquest into the death of a man shot by Vancouver police on Boxing Day.

Coroner Stephen Fonseca announced Friday that the inquest into the death of Gerald Chenery is slated to begin on Nov. 7. It will be held at Burnaby's Coroner's Court and is expected to last several days.

Chenery was brandishing two steak knives when he was repeatedly shot by two junior Vancouver Police Department officers in the 200- block East Hastings Street on Dec. 26. The 29-year-old was hit 15 times.
One officer said she fired at Chenery four times, hitting him once. He then jumped on top of her and began slashing at her before her partner fired 11 shots at Chenery's back.
Fonseca and a five-member jury will hear evidence during the inquest, which can make recommendations aimed at preventing similar deaths in the future.
